$comment: Non-frontmatter dependency edges for installer/init.mjs. The PRIMARY dependency source is agent frontmatter permissions rules (action:"skill" allows = requiresSkills, action:"subagent" allows = delegatesTo). This map covers edges frontmatter cannot express: impliesMcp (skill->MCP: when a skill is installed, the listed MCP server(s) should also be enabled — values MUST match mcp.servers.<key> in deploy/opencode.json), requiresSkills (skill->skill: when a skill is installed, the listed skill(s) are auto-installed too, mirroring SKILL.md prerequisite declarations; --no-deps opts out), and shipsPlugins (skill->plugin artifacts: repo plugins/ entries copied into the target's opencode plugin dir so runtime enforcement travels with the skill — opencode targets only; non-opencode targets get a notice; --no-deps opts out. Trailing-slash entries mean the whole directory). The requiresSkills entries must match tests/test_skill_isolation.bats HANDOFF1_OWNER/HANDOFF1_TARGETS, HANDOFF2_OWNER/HANDOFF2_TARGETS, HANDOFF3_OWNERS/HANDOFF3_TARGETS, HANDOFF4_OWNER/HANDOFF4_TARGETS, and HANDOFF5_OWNER/HANDOFF5_TARGETS (multi-owner pair: every owner in HANDOFF3_OWNERS maps to every target in HANDOFF3_TARGETS; source of truth per AGENTS.md §Skill Isolation Contract); shipsPlugins is a skill->plugin edge, deliberately outside that invariant.

pluginCompanions.$comment: plugin -> companion artifacts in repo plugins/ that must land beside the plugin for it to work (trailing slash = whole directory). Consumed by the --select picker deploy path in deploy/setup.sh apply_selected_packs_extras (#537); the manifest path's shipsPlugins stays the skill->plugin edge. ONE declarative home for companion knowledge — never fork it into shell case arms.
